companyDescription: Launch + lunar + defense · Alpha rocket + Blue Ghost lunar lander + SciTec (space domain awareness) · Q2 2026 revenue up 659% YoY to a record $117.7M, FY26 guidance raised to $420-450M — the real story is fundamentals genuinely improving while the stock has actually given back ground since the pre-earnings pop
priceNote: Live $23.70 on Nov 11, 2026. The prior report (Sep 29) used $23.24 (+2.0%) but was 43 days old. Q3 was reported Nov 10 after the close.
summary: RESOLVED (Q3, Nov 10) — a revenue beat with a guide nudge. Revenue was $110.7M (+260% y/y) vs ~$102M est., driven by spacecraft (SciTec, Blue Ghost, Elytra). Launch revenue fell ~50% to $4.7M. The FY26 guide low end was raised to $440–450M, and backlog hit a record $1.7B. The net loss widened (-$0.45 to -$0.56/share depending on source), and coverage notes the stock fell. Alpha Block II remains overdue (Alpha launches cut to three this year). With no dated catalyst left, the report goes post-stage. Core Base bias +23.7pp vs realized 14d P75 +6.6%, so Base is a multi-week horizon, not a 14-day call.

catalysts.name: Q3 2026 earnings — RESOLVED
catalysts.description: Rev $110.7M beat; FY26 $440–450M; backlog $1.7B; launch rev -50%.

catalysts.name: Alpha Block II debut (Flight 8)
catalysts.description: Overdue; a Q4 Alpha launch is guided without a date.

risks: Alpha Flight 8 (full Block II configuration) has slipped past its own 'late summer 2026' guided window with no new confirmed date as of late Sep 2026 — a real, live schedule risk that the Aug 10 report expected to be resolved by now
FY26 guidance of $420-450M implies a steep H2 ramp from the $117.7M Q2 print — Nov 11 earnings is a genuine test of execution, not just a formality

The stock's -13.0% drift since the Aug 10 report despite record Q2 results, alongside a $40.64→$38.60 consensus-target trim, shows the market pricing in real execution skepticism, not just profit-taking
Net loss was $92.3M in Q2 despite the revenue beat — still cash-burning at scale even as growth accelerates
Heavy dilution history: shares outstanding grew significantly post-IPO and post-SciTec — further issuance risk remains live
Extreme realized volatility even on good news — the stock has swung double digits in both directions repeatedly through 2026

analystTargets.note: Down from $40.64 last report despite the stock itself falling — a real, incremental caution signal, not just a trailing artifact

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: The space sector's sentiment has stabilized somewhat as Firefly's own fundamentals caught up to the news flow, but the sector remains sensitive to broad risk-off moves and capital rotation (e.g. toward SpaceX's IPO).
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — a 25bp December hike is priced after the hot CPI. The tails are a 50bp move or a hot Nov 25 PCE, both of which hit small caps first, so the dip entry is preferred.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE hold — the Q3 binary resolved as a spacecraft-driven beat. Launch (Alpha) is still the weak link, with no dated next catalyst. Measured core at-catalyst median is -6.9% (n=54), so Entry 2 is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Firefly ran +11% into the Aug 11 print itself, but has since drifted down -13.0% net versus the Aug 10 report price even with record results — showing the pre-earnings run had already pulled forward most of the near-term optimism
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: 1-2 weeks before a confirmed print, based on the Aug 11 pattern
catalystSpot.preRunupPct: +10% to +15% typical pre-print, though this can fully reverse post-print as it did this cycle

postWin.note: Comparable space-sector names show 5-20% pops on major beats. Firefly's own Aug 11 print delivered the beat and guidance raise, but the stock's net move since then has been negative (-13.0% vs the pre-print price) — a reminder that a clean beat doesn't guarantee a sustained positive reaction if the run-up already priced it in.

postLose.note: Firefly's own stock fell -27.9% over 30 days in Jul 2026 purely on sentiment (before fundamentals caught up) — the direct precedent for how much this stock can still fall on a Nov 11 guidance miss or a further Alpha Flight 8 delay.

spotSizing.reason: Real fundamentals improvement supports a moderate core-lane size, but the still-undated Alpha Flight 8 debut and the post-earnings price drift argue against sizing up further until Nov 11 or a confirmed Flight 8 date

stopPostCatalyst.note: If Nov 11 guidance disappoints relative to the $420-450M FY26 range, or Alpha Flight 8 suffers a failure, exit
